sn32.13-52:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn32.13-52:1.3: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā uṇhavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn32.13-52:1.7: idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati vācāya sucaritaṃ carati manasā sucaritaṃ carati
sn32.13-52:1.11: aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā vassavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyanti.
sn32.13-52:1.12: so annaṃ deti pānaṃ deti vatthaṃ deti yānaṃ deti mālaṃ deti gandhaṃ deti vilepanaṃ deti seyyaṃ deti āvasathaṃ deti
sn32.13-52:1.14: so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā vassavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
sn32.13-52:1.15: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā vassavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
